paragraphs: We offer family-friendly, family-focused modern dental care for the Wakefield community.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Welcome to our Wakefield office! Our office stands out with its modern atmosphere and advanced technology, making your dental experience stress-free. Our skillful and attentive team strongly believes that dental care and treatment start with patient comfort. Therefore, we designed our office and amenities with your health and well-being in mind. Our patients feel supported and at ease, leaving motivated and confident to care for their oral health.

Our Wakefield location is conveniently situated in a suburban community, just off Capital Boulevard. It offers small-town charm with easy access to Forest Ridge Park and Wakefield Crossing Shopping Center. We provide care for the Wakefield community and patients traveling from the nearby neighborhoods such as Wake Forest, Rolesville, New Hope, and more. Our connection with clients goes beyond the dental chair. You are now part of the Riccobene family, where we are committed to providing the comfort and confidence you need for a healthy, painless smile!
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Raleigh office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.
We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!
Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include teeth whitening.

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!
Yes! We have an amazing team of professionals ready to help you with your Invisalign® needs to discreetly straighten your teeth for a brighter, natural smile.
Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants, bridges, dentures, and crowns.
We recommend scheduling dental checkups every six months, though if your needs require more frequent visits, our expert team will provide you with the care you deserve.
At Wakefield, we offer a variety of sedation dentistry options. You can choose from Nitrous Oxide, IV Sedation, and Local Anesthesia

We use digital X-rays, which have a small sensor and X-ray film tabs, as well as panoramic X-rays, where you stand still while a machine rotates around your head and takes a single image of your entire mouth.
Yes, we offer oral cancer screenings. Early cancer detection is critical for proper treatment and recovery. Your health is our priority.
Yes. Our expert team can remove your wisdom teeth before or after they come in. We prioritize your comfort throughout the process and make sure the removal process is painless and relaxing.
Absolutely. At our office, we recognize the importance of preventive dental care for your oral health and provide services including fluoride and sealants.
Take the first step towards optimal oral health. Contact our Raleigh office to schedule your appointment or ask any questions about our dental services.
Fill out the form below and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.
Select a Location to schedule an appointment:
Call our Wakefield Office at 919-556-6666, or use the form below to request an appointment.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What dental services are offered at the Wakefield office?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

What cosmetic dentistry options are available in Wakefield?

Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include teeth whitening.

Can I receive emergency dental care the same day in Wakefield?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Do you provide Invisalign® clear aligners in Wakefield?

Yes! We have an amazing team of professionals ready to help you with your Invisalign® needs to discreetly straighten your teeth for a brighter, natural smile.

Do you offer dental implants or implant-supported dentures in Wakefield?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants, bridges, dentures, and crowns.

How often should I schedule routine cleanings in Wakefield?

We recommend scheduling dental checkups every six months, though if your needs require more frequent visits, our expert team will provide you with the care you deserve.

Are sedation dentistry options available for anxious patients in Wakefield?

At Wakefield, we offer a variety of sedation dentistry options. You can choose from Nitrous Oxide, IV Sedation, and Local Anesthesia

What X-ray technology does your Wakefield office use for modern dental care?

We use digital X-rays, which have a small sensor and X-ray film tabs, as well as panoramic X-rays, where you stand still while a machine rotates around your head and takes a single image of your entire mouth.

Do you perform oral cancer screenings at your Wakefield location?

Yes, we offer oral cancer screenings. Early cancer detection is critical for proper treatment and recovery. Your health is our priority.

Do you remove wisdom teeth in Wakefield?

Yes. Our expert team can remove your wisdom teeth before or after they come in. We prioritize your comfort throughout the process and make sure the removal process is painless and relaxing.

What preventive treatments, like fluoride or sealants, are offered in Wakefield?

Absolutely. At our office, we recognize the importance of preventive dental care for your oral health and provide services including fluoride and sealants.
